text:
Anya: Quick sanity check 10m. I made a compact notify-preview variant that packs rows tighter to avoid scrolling. Figma: https://figma.com/file/xyz789/compact-preview

Sam: Sweet. Immediate issue: when pills wrap the tab order feels scrambled. Using flex-wrap keeps DOM order different from visual order.

Priya: A11y note: screen reader reads each pill as just "button". Add aria-label like "Email  Notifying" or "Slack  Suppressed by schedule". Also use aria-pressed for toggles.

Lucy: Grid with explicit rows fixed tab order for me. But long names broke truncation. Suggest truncate + aria-describedby pointing to offscreen full-name. Tooltip on hover/focus covers sighted users.

Anya: Copy check: current action says "Mute"  product uses "Snooze" elsewhere. We should standardize to "Snooze". I'll update mocks.

Sam: Live announcements: when user snoozes, write a polite live region: "Snoozed Slack for 1 hour". Avoid announcing bulk preview recomputes while dragging slider or virtualizing. Batch updates.

Priya: When virtualization is used, keep a separate live-region for user actions (not list diffs) so SR doesn't get recycled DOM noise. Also ensure focus returns to originating pill after closing suppression drawer.

Lucy: Contrast: pill text at 12px fails 4.5:1 on dark backgrounds. Use slightly darker text or 600 weight. If channel color is custom, compute a readable foreground at runtime and fallback to outline if it fails.

a11y-bot: Checklist: role+aria-pressed on pills, aria-label includes status, stable DOM order = visual order, truncated names via aria-describedby and tooltip, aria-live only for user actions, focus management for drawers, contrast >= 4.5:1, run axe + NVDA manual pass.

Anya: Thanks  I'll update prototype with grid + tooltips, change copy to "Snooze", and add the aria-live strings. Who can pair on the DOM reorder PR tomorrow?

Sam: I can pair after 2pm.
